turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyText:
Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?Ask MaggieA damaged item is handled similarly to a normal return, but you should contact customer service immediately with your order number, a description of the issue, and photos if possible. We'll arrange a replacement or repair at no cost if it falls under warranty or was an error on our part.

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyText:
long does the replacement take?Ask MaggieThe replacement process typically takes a few business days. Once your replacement is shipped, you'll receive a separate email with a tracking number to keep you updated on its progress.

Title: How do I track my order?
When your order ships you will receive a separate email providing you with a tracking number to track your order.
Sometimes this email gets sorted into spam or promotions folders so be sure to take a look in there if it feels like you have been waiting a little too long.
*Please note that sometimes the tracking can take a day or two to be updated by the carrier. If it looks like it's not moving, chances are its on its way!

Title: How long will it take to receive my order?
Standard Orders will typically ship pack and ship in 2-4 business days (Mon-Fri) and you will receive your order in 3-4 business days (Mon-Fri) once shipped.
Expedited Orders received by 12pm PST ship same day (M-F) otherwise will ship out in 2 to 4 weekdays.
